messages:
Sam: quick follow-up from the trace/metrics RFC thread — I'm worried the current envelope-only cost tagging misses per-model-run granularity when we do batching + retries.
Anya: can you sketch an example failure mode?
Sam: imagine a single request gets split across two gpu shards, and one shard retries a subset. envelope-level cost ties to request_id only, we can't attribute the extra tokens/retries to the original model_run (and replays lose mapping). :thinking:
Devon: hmm. do you mean we need a stable model_run_id propagated on spans & metrics?
Sam: exactly. proposal: add a lightweight "ri.model_run_id" on span-level attributes and a small cost_summary on terminal spans. That way cost attribution can roll up by model_run even if envelope is re-enveloped or split.
Maria: sounds reasonable. storage/cost tradeoff though — adding fields to every span increases cardinality. what's the plan to avoid explosion?
Sam: two mitigations: 1) keep model_run_id as a short hash (8-12 chars), 2) only attach it to spans that actually incur token cost (generation spans). for other spans we keep the envelope id only.
Anya: Also: sampling. If we drop spans before we see terminal spans, rollups will miss costs. We need sampling rules that preferentially keep end-of-inference spans or a tiny cost-summary event.
Devon: agree. we could emit a compact cost marker event to our ingest pipeline (minimal fields) that is sampled separately from trace sampling. e.g.:
```
{
  "trace_id": "t-abc",
  "model_run_id": "mr-1a2b3c",
  "model": "redwood-7b-q4",
  "tokens": 128,
  "cost_usd": 0.0012,
  "final": true
}
```
Sam: that marker could be what we keep at higher retention and use to reconcile aggregated billing, while full spans live on normal retention.
Maria: who owns emitting the marker? runtime or agent sidecar? if runtime can cheaply emit it, we keep envelope smaller.
Anya: runtime is best placed since it knows exact token counts and quantization variant. sidecar might not have that detail.
Devon: implementation detail — add a lightweight protobuf for the marker and a dedicated Kafka topic with compacted keys (model_run_id) so we can materialize per-run aggregates cheaply.
Sam: good idea. compaction means we can reduce storage while keeping latest final marker. also helps when retries emit multiple markers — compaction + last-write-wins (final=true wins).
Maria: concerns: compaction semantics across partitions and ordering. we'll need a sequence number or final flag to pick the right marker.
Anya: plus, we should version the schema: marker_v1 with fields above, and marker_v2 later for edge cases (multi-model compositional runs). Put a schema id on the message.
Sam: action items: (1) RFC note: add model_run_id as optional span attr and define when to attach (Sam), (2) proto for cost_marker and topic semantics (Devon), (3) sampling updates to keep cost_markers and terminal spans (Anya), (4) quick POC on compacted topic and aggregator (Maria). I'll take (1) and coordinate.
obs-bot: Sam pinned the message — next steps added to #eng-platform backlog :white_check_mark:
Maria: thanks — I'll sync with infra on compaction guarantees tomorrow.
